name: GetAllServiceNowIncidents
label: Get All ServiceNow Incidents
description: Retrieves all or limited incidents from ServiceNow using a stored credential. Supports pagination.

fields.name: CredentialId
fields.label: Credential
fields.description: Select the stored ServiceNow credential by ID

fields.name: ReturnAll
fields.label: Return All
fields.description: If enabled, retrieves all incidents across all pages. If disabled, only returns up to 'Limit' records from the first page.

fields.name: Limit
fields.label: Limit
fields.description: Maximum number of incidents to retrieve per request (used when Return All is off). Max: 1000.

fields.name: Response
fields.label: API Response
fields.description: Raw JSON response from the last page (or first if error)

fields.name: Incidents
fields.label: Incidents
fields.description: List of incident objects as JObject array
